concerns.text: FR-002 (rate-limiting and exponential backoff for API calls) has no task. The coverage table claims 'FR-001/002 (API) | T004', but T004's requirements list only mentions source restriction, filtering, multi-arm handling, and field extraction — no backoff/rate-limiting requirement. An implementer following T004 verbatim will skip FR-002.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004/T007 vs spec.md:FR-003 and plan.md:Phase 2 Task 4
concerns.text: No task extracts mindfulness intervention components (breathing, body scan, movement). T007 requires 'Compare mindfulness components (breathing, body scan, etc.)' and the effect_size schema requires a component_tag enum, but T004's extraction requirements cover only delivery_format and social_skill_domain. The component data T007 depends on is never produced.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 vs spec.md:FR-009 and plan.md:Phase 2 Task 4
concerns.text: FR-009 (abstract-only text-extraction fallback, no full-text OCR) is specified in plan Task 4 but appears nowhere in T004's requirements or any other task; the coverage table omits FR-009 entirely.
US1 acceptance criterion requires output 'data/raw/excluded_studies.log', but T004's outputs are only verified_snapshot_2026.json and cleaned_studies.csv. No task produces the exclusion audit trail.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006/T007 vs spec.md:FR-014 and plan.md:Phase 4 Task 10
concerns.text: FR-014 and US2 require conditional suppression of meta-regression when N < 10, but no task implements meta-regression at all — T006/T007 cover pooling and subgroups only. The coverage table masks this by mapping FR-014 solely to funnel-plot suppression (T008/T009), which is US3's N≥10 rule, not FR-014.

T007 introduces a 'blinding bias (blinded vs unblinded raters)' subgroup dimension that exists in no FR, no plan task, and no data-model field (no rater-blinding column in any schema). This is an orphan task requirement with no extractable data source; either the spec/plan must be amended or the dimension removed.

No task pins random seeds in code/ (Principle I) or records checksums for files under data/ (Principle III). T010 verifies CI/local artifact-hash equality but nothing creates the checksummed baseline of raw/processed data that verification depends on.

Plan Task 12 requires the report generator to handle the N=0 case (stating 'No studies found'); T009's requirements cover only N<10 and N≥10 branches, so the N=0 branch of the plan element is uncovered.
Plan's rigor section mandates 'Bonferroni correction applied to p-values in subgroup analyses', but T007's requirements omit any multiple-comparison correction.

Stale/incorrect tag: the table maps 'FR-014 (N < 10 Logic)' to funnel-plot suppression in T008/T009, but FR-014 is meta-regression suppression; funnel/Egger gating is US3/FR-006 territory. Also FR-003, FR-005, FR-007, FR-009, FR-010, FR-012 have no rows in the coverage table despite (partial) task coverage existing for some — the table is not a reliable traceability map.
